app/input.css is tailwind.Input with the Twind preset; TestAppFixtureMatchesPreset fails when the preset changes.
Run from the repository root:

.twind/bin/tailwindcss-windows-x64.exe -i twi/tailwind/testdata/tailwind-4.3.3/app/input.css -o twi/tailwind/testdata/tailwind-4.3.3/app/output.css

SHA-256 of the output:
c7526c580b552ed4580e0f21961d9a5d4e079b247e78a74954bd57f34155d04e  app/output.css

app/output.css is also the compiler corpus: tailwind.Inputs hashes Compile of it into every generated IR,
so recapturing it makes every committed IR stale until regenerated.
